text: what was done to those Christians, and they exiled [[Dhu Nuwas|ذو نواس]]. They wanted to catch him, he tried to escape, but he was killed, he died while he was trying to flee. And the Abyssinian Christian kingdom took control of [[Yemen|اليمن]]
under the army of [[Abraha|أبرهة]]. And they remained in control of [[Yemen|اليمن]] for about 70 years.
And you know the name of [[Abraha|أبرهة]] because he is the one who then went on to try to destroy the house of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]], the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]].
And that incident happened in the year that the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was born, and that story is recounted in Surah al-Fil.
And that happened in the year of the birth of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, which we will get into next week [[insha'Allah|إن شاء الله]].

translit: Wallāhu aʿlam, wa ṣallallāhu wa sallama wa bāraka ʿalā nabiyyinā Muḥammad wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn.

text: And Allah knows best, and may the peace, blessings, and grace of Allah be upon our Prophet Muhammad, and upon his family and all his companions.
